changes.comment: The `reply` tool now takes exactly `chat_id`, optional `message_id`, and `text`; the `mention_user_ids` argument is gone, and a mention is written in the body with Feishu's own `<at user_id="ou_example">Example</at>` syntax, which the tool description now shows. Replies are still delivered as Markdown cards, now one Markdown element per card: a leading heading is no longer lifted into the card title and a table is no longer a native table element. A Team the channel provisions automatically for a Collaboration Space topic is now created with the space's configured identity followed by its bound reply address — the chat and the message that triggered creation — so the leader can still address the conversation after a compaction; the space policy is unchanged. A failed send now reports the platform's own status, code, reason, and log id in the channel log and the MCP failure.
